title: Mac incremental input optimization: public numeric evidence
publicationScope: Numeric aggregate only. No project/SDK source, query payload, edit body, private path, snapshot, protocol transcript or raw archive.

caveats: RSS once per PID; Worker shares server PID. Native index is a separate process.
Do not sum independent role maxima; tree peak is computed from same-sample unique PID totals.
250ms sampled RSS is a lower bound, not allocation maximum/PSS.
Only stable-phase RSS samples enter phase stats. Zero samples = unmeasured, never zero memory.
Memory mode adds trace/probes, 2s initial/final idle and about 1s after each operation; do not pool time/peaks with ordinary mode.
After-operation last is the last available sample in that observation interval, not the response instant.
Isolate heap/external/arrayBuffers are separate from RSS; Worker timers can miss synchronous-work peaks.
All runs degraded; this does not establish READY, long-term pressure, larger-scale, 500ms or final check:fast qualification.

limitations: 500ms performance remains FAIL. Functional pass and timing qualification are separate; all slow samples are retained.
Every scale-comparison run was SDK degraded (unresolved SDK module, diagnostic 2307). Complete SDK/project READY behavior is unqualified.

Only total unreferenced-source growth at 2048 and 20000 was controlled. Active module 19 sources, active closure 18 sources/17 edges/depth17 and query target remain fixed. Added noise is not additional effective dependency.
Rename and edited references still construct a global Program containing all project sources. Program input scope and createProgram counts did not decrease.
Growing fanout/depth, shared dependencies, single-module 20000-source projects, larger real ArkTS source bodies and long-running pressure/soak remain unqualified.
Small synthetic .ts sources do not qualify arbitrary real .ets project complexity. Two size points do not establish O(N), O(N log N), O(N squared) or a general memory-complexity bound.
Each trial uses a new process and application index, but initialization prepares Programs before the first query. First disk completion is not an AST-cold-start measurement.
Preflight hashes read fixture files; OS page-cache state is uncontrolled. New process does not prove cold filesystem.
RPC ends after full Content-Length response decode; editor rendering is excluded and initialization is separate.
Rename completes before returned edits are applied and references begins. Times are independent; normal references can include pending edit application.
Repeated completion is a sequence label, not proof of result-cache hit. References MISS/STORE/HIT observation is separate from Program/AST reuse.
Ordinary, memory, Program and detailed-diagnostic runs are independent; their timings and proportions must not be pooled or substituted.
RSS is counted once per PID; Worker and server share one Node PID and native index is separate. Isolate heap is not added to RSS. Role maxima are not summed into a co-temporal tree peak.
250ms RSS sampling is a lower bound, not PSS/allocation maximum. Missing operation samples are unmeasured, never zero memory.
Memory mode adds tracing/probes, two-second initial/final idle and about one-second post-operation windows. After-operation last means observation-window sample, not response instant.
Candidate did not demonstrate lower resident or peak RSS. Isolate timers can miss synchronous peaks. RSS differences are not attributed to metadata or GC.
Compiler subphases, OS IO wait, native-index internals, exact GC pauses, unhooked parser helpers and incremental child-node reuse remain unmeasured.
32MiB identity budget is an accounting estimate, not an RSS cap; its exact byte-overflow boundary was not exercised by the 8250-input regression.
Cold-owner pressure characterization did not prove that a former shared Registry entry remained alive; it is not a GC-reuse proof.
A pre-existing stale-completion counterexample after unnotified ambient-input edit was reproduced in both implementations in a separate READY fixture. This change does not fix it.

General cross-group reference completeness, root READY consumers, complete rename semantics under a new search architecture and namespace/alias/ancestor-ABA proofs remain open. Position unions or watcher delivery alone do not establish semantic authority.
Import-regex prefix trimming preserves prior captures but does not solve worst-case quoted-region work or guarantee all inputs improve.
Windows and historical/intermediate-candidate measurements are not pooled into this final paired matrix.
Measured snapshot local check:fast pass does not replace release-gate/CI qualification for a later public merge commit.

derivation.ordinary: Select final-v2 baseline only. Require rounds1/2/3 for each size/variant/operation. Recalculate median/max and match all56 existing statistics. Sequence0 initialization excluded from query threshold count.
derivation.memory: Whitelist four numeric groups; independently verify every n/values/median/maximum tuple using non-null values. Preserve null round values and missing sample counts.
derivation.program: Whitelist84 actual returns, exclude timestamps/IDs/paths; validate seven builds per round and each phase project/SDK/library scope.
